COLDWAR_CYP_R2_enact_federal_compact = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CYP_R2_new_compact_execution_valid = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_offer_pending
			GRE = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
			TUR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
			ENG = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0075 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_constitutional_settlement_earned
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_constitutional_settlement_stability_factor = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_constitutional_settlement_bureaucracy_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.1 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_constitution_ratified
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_new_compact_enacted
		COLDWAR_CYP_R2_refresh_programmes = yes
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_offer_pending
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_new_compact_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_CYP_R2_new_compact_execution_valid = yes
		}
		GRE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
		TUR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
		ENG = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_offer_window_active days = 90 value = 1 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_offer_pending
		GRE = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_DOM.10 days = 1 } }
		TUR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_DOM.10 days = 1 } }
		ENG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_DOM.10 days = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_DOM.11 days = 90 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_streams = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_expenses = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = CYP
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_initialized
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_expenses = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_common_weekly_fraction }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_expenses = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_party_1_weekly_fraction }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_expenses = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_party_2_weekly_fraction }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_expenses = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_party_4_weekly_fraction }
		}
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_weekly_expenses = gdp_total }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_set_leader = {
	update_set_politics = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 0 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Western_Autocracy }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_makarios_deceased
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Spyros Kyprianou" picture = "gfx/leaders/CYP/1970/COLDWAR_CYP_1970_Spyros_Kyprianou.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = conservatism }
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = { name = "Makarios III" picture = "gfx/leaders/CYP/1970/COLDWAR_CYP_1970_makarios.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = conservatism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Glafkos Clerides" picture = "gfx/leaders/CYP/1970/COLDWAR_CYP_1970_clerides.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = liberalism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Vassos Lyssarides" picture = "gfx/leaders/CYP/1970/COLDWAR_CYP_1970_Vassos_Lyssarides.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = socialism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Ezekias Papaioannou" picture = "gfx/leaders/CYP/1970/COLDWAR_CYP_1970_Ezekias_Papaioannou.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = communist_state }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 5 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = anarchist_communism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 6 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Conservative }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 7 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Autocracy }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 8 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Mod_Vilayat_e_Faqih }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 9 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Vilayat_e_Faqih }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 10 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Kingdom }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 11 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Caliphate }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 12 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Neutral_Muslim_Brotherhood }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 13 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Neutral_Autocracy }

		else_if = {

			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 15 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = oligarchism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 16 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Neutral_Libertarian }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 17 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Neutral_green }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 } }
			create_country_leader = { name = "Cypriot National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/NCY/1970/COLDWAR_NCY_1970_generic.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = neutral_Social }

					date > 1974.1.26
				}

			}

		COLDWAR_CYP_R2_refresh_programmes = yes
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_last_party = ruling_party }
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_install_coup_government = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_pre_coup_party_saved }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_pre_coup_party = ruling_party }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_pre_coup_party_saved
	}
	set_variable = { ruling_party = 20 }
	set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = no }
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_coup_government
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_coup_regime_active
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_crisis_active
	COLDWAR_CYP_R2_set_leader = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_restore_civilian_government = {
	set_variable = { ruling_party = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_pre_coup_party }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_coup_government
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_coup_regime_active
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_civilian_restored
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_coup_resolved
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
		}
		set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes }
	}
	else = {
		set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_CYP_R2_set_leader = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_core_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			date > 1977.8.2
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_makarios_deceased }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_makarios_deceased
		COLDWAR_CYP_R2_set_leader = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_last_party = ruling_party } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CYP_R2_set_leader = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CYP_R2_refresh_programmes = yes
	COLDWAR_EASTMED_CYP_1970_daily_tick = yes
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = CYP
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_initialized }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_initialized
		load_focus_tree = COLDWAR_CYP_1970_focus
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_communal_confidence = 35 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_officer_penetration = 45 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_CYP_R2_presidential_preparedness = 0 }
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_broken_constitutional_partnership
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_separate_communal_administrations
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_divided_national_guard_command
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_enosis_underground_networks
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_limited_technical_capacity
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_makarios_presidential_authority
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_unficyp_presence
		add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_1960_treaty_of_guarantee
		GRE = { if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_1960_treaty_of_guarantee } }
		TUR = { if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_1960_treaty_of_guarantee } }
		ENG = { if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_idea_1960_treaty_of_guarantee } }
		COLDWAR_CYP_R2_set_leader = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_proposal_failed = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_offer_pending
	GRE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
	TUR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
	ENG = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_federal_assent }
	uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = COLDWAR_CYP_R2_new_compact uncomplete_children = no refund_political_power = no }
}
